I'm a Software engineer specializing in **Minecraft Bedrock's network protocol** and **offensive security research**.

My work takes place within reverse engineering and low-level systems,
inspecting Bedrock's binary protocol, analyzing internal APIs, 
and building tooling.

## what i build

I primarily create low-level packet manipulation tools, MITM proxies.
Bot infrastructure and Game client architecture.

Tools I'm interested in but don't work with often are.
Minecraft Bedrock add-ons which I find fun with the visual results, more focused on resource packs.
Then I also work on Offensive security tooling, to find vulnerabilities in BDS, realms, and worlds

## reverse engineering focus

Bedrock documentation is limited. Everything I work with is 
decided from analysis, and packet capture reading the binary.
